name: setxattr
synopsis: int setxattr(const char *path, const char *name, const void *value, size_t size, int flags);
int lsetxattr(const char *path, const char *name, const void *value, size_t size, int flags);
int fsetxattr(int fd, const char *name, const void *value, size_t size, int flags);
description: Sets the value of an extended attribute for a specified file or directory. Extended attributes are name:value pairs associated with inodes. Variants like lsetxattr() and fsetxattr() allow setting attributes on symbolic links or open files respectively.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file or directory (for setxattr and lsetxattr)

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open file (for fsetxattr)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the extended attribute, including namespace prefix

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Pointer to the value to set

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the value in bytes

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to control behavior, such as XATTR_CREATE or XATTR_REPLACE

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Disk quota limits meant that there is insufficient space remaining to store the extended attribute
XATTR_CREATE was specified, and the attribute exists already
XATTR_REPLACE was specified, and the attribute does not exist
There is insufficient space remaining to store the extended attribute
The namespace prefix of name is not valid, or extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem
The file is marked immutable or append-only
The size of name or value exceeds a filesystem-specific limit
